class.name: NavigationTransitionRule3D
class.brief_description: Hook that adds extra source geometry to a [NavigationRegion3D] bake.
class.description: Assign to [member NavigationRegion3D.transition_rules]. Before baking, [method _collect_source_geometry] may add geometry that the scene parsers do not find, for example collision bodies created internally by a node. Traversal surfaces are baked by the engine from [member NavigationRegion3D.traversal_rules].

method.name: _collect_source_geometry
method.description: Optionally adds geometry to the region's parsed bake input before generating the walking mesh and the traversal surfaces. Called on the main thread. In the editor, implement this method in a tool script.
